rows.en:
(Klan-senpai and I promised to go
shopping at Folmo today, but...)

Sorry I'm late,
\p.
Oh, no, it's no problem at all...

(I never thought she'd show up
at Zentradi size...)
Klan-senpai, can I ask you two questions?
Why did you come macronized?
rows.notes: Both genders. Zentora-ka = macronized, as slice 335 (Klan's card).

rows.en:
Well...
I got treated like a kid at the movie theater
the other day, that's why...
rows.notes: Both genders. Refers to the adult-ticket scene in frd_kln_002.

rows.en: (So it did bother her after all...)

And my second question...
How are we supposed to go shopping together?

Hm? You can just follow along
behind me, can't you?
All right, let's go shopping!
I ended up buying way too much.

Y-yeah...
More importantly, I'm already worn out......

Tired already?
You've got no stamina at all.

(Please think about the difference
in our strides...)
Klan-senpai, this really isn't working...
What isn't?

How do I put it...
It doesn't feel like we're shopping together.
That's right!
rows.notes: x4: player here (both genders), Shirakawa in frd_myk_006. Generic.

rows.en: Then next time, you come macronized too.

That way we'd be evenly matched,
so there'd be no problem, right?
W-well, that's true, but...
rows.notes: Both genders. The joke: a human can't macronize.

rows.en:
Heh, I'm only joking...
Next time I'll come micronized as usual.

Sorry for making you go out of your way
for me...

Don't worry about it. That's the least
I can do as your senior.
rows.notes: Both genders. senpai used as a common noun: 'your senior'.

rows.en:
Well, I've bought most of what I wanted,
so let's head home.
Sorry for dragging you along today.
Not at all. Please invite me again.

Mm, I'll do that.
See you.

(Macronized Klan-senpai seems more grown-up,
not just in looks but in how she acts, too...)
rows.notes: Both genders. seishinteki ni = mentally; 'in how she acts' reads more naturally.

rows.en: (Hmm, which one is the real Klan-senpai?)

(I never thought she'd show up
at Zentradi size...)
(So it did bother her after all...)

Y-yeah...
More importantly, I'm already worn out......

That way we'd be evenly matched,
so there'd be no problem, right?
(Hmm, which one is the real Klan-senpai?)

(Today I'm going to enjoy shopping
at Folmo with Klan-senpai!)

(Hmm, I wonder if Klan-senpai will show up
macronized again like last time?)

Hey, \p.
Here before me? Good for you.

Oh, Klan-senpai.
You came micronized today.

I promised you last time, didn't I?
I'm a grown woman who keeps her promises.

Haha, that's true.
Well then, shall we go shopping?
Mm-hm!
rows.notes: x8: Klan here and frd_kln_006, nml_kln_015; Pinon in nml_pnn_019. Generic assent.

rows.en:
(Shopping like this really is
more fun.)

(Today I'm going to enjoy shopping
at Folmo with Klan-senpai!)

(Hmm, I wonder if Klan-senpai will show up
macronized again like last time?)

(Shopping like this really is
more fun.)

(Klan-senpai and I are going to have fun
at the Mihoshi Academy pool, but...)

(Klan-senpai already graduated from Mihoshi,
so is she even allowed in?)

Even a school I know so well
feels nostalgic once you've graduated...

Klan-senpai, is this really okay?
Just walking into the Mihoshi pool like this?

You fool.
Of course I got permission.
As an adult, that's only common courtesy.
Then we can have fun without worrying.

Exactly. Hurry up and change,
we're hitting the pool!
Uhh... um, Klan-senpai?

If you're wearing "that",
does that mean...?
rows.notes: Both genders. 'That' = the float ring (named in c07862).

rows.en:
It can't be helped!
For some reason, when I micronize,
I can't swim anymore!!

So... I'm only wearing this
because I have no choice...!

"No choice"? Come on...
Don't worry about it, Klan-senpai.

That float ring looks great on you.
Any way you look at it, you look just like
an elementary schooler!
rows.notes: Both genders. shotoubu no ko = elementary-school kid; wording as slice c21261.

rows.en: Come on, let's go have fun, Klan-senpai.
You...
What's wrong, Klan-senpai?

You're awfully cheeky for a junior!
I'll teach you a lesson!!
rows.notes: Both genders. seibai shite kureru rendered 'I'll teach you a lesson' (also c07889, c08196).

rows.en: Hiyaaah~~~!!
Waaaaaah!!
We played just like we were kids again.

(Though you still look like nothing
but a kid to me, Senpai...)

You just thought something rude,
didn't you?
N-no, I didn't...
Hmph, fine then...

I'm tired from swimming.
Shall we head home soon?
We're coming swimming again.
Okay, I'll be looking forward to it.

(I'm glad I got to have fun at the pool
with Klan-senpai today.)

(Still, Klan-senpai...
That float ring suited her shockingly well......)

(Klan-senpai already graduated from Mihoshi,
so is she even allowed in?)
Kyaaaaaah!!

(I'm glad I got to have fun at the pool
with Klan-senpai today.)

(Still, Klan-senpai...
That float ring suited her shockingly well......)

uncertain: Zentora-ka / Zentora-saizu rendered 'macronized' / 'Zentradi size' (no glossary entry; 'macronized' follows Klan's card in slice 335; micronize is in terms.json).
c07866 seibai shite kureru: 'I'll teach you a lesson!!' (Klan's mock-samurai 'I'll punish you'); same wording planned for c07889 and c08196.
c07827 senpai as a common noun rendered 'as your senior' per the brief.
missing_glossary: Zentora-ka (Klan's macronization, 'macronized') has no terms.json entry; only micronize does.
